name: Mitch Sabbagh
detail: Listed as 'Mitch Sabbagh (NS)' in the Patriotic Millionaires Canada press release of 30 October 2025 and known only from that line. Removed on 31 October 2026 for two reasons. (1) A message sent through the site's feedback form on 30 October from someone giving this name asks for the entry to be removed because he opposes a wealth tax; the sender could not be verified. (2) A Substack post of 20 June 2026 says a Mitch Sabbagh argued in the Chronicle Herald (Halifax) on 18 June 2026 that we should stop worrying about taxing the rich; this is a second-hand summary, the column itself was not found, and the link to the same person rests on the name and the Nova Scotia paper. The press release still lists him. He is not a public figure otherwise, so the entry is closed on caution.
